annotations.title: Check a CTA before an ad

description:
[read-only] Checks whether a draft, post or link points at the brand's goal page (the same check the ad and boost routes run in paid mode; a block there refuses the ad). Run it before every boost or ad and paste the result. Nothing stored, free. Needs the Pro plan or higher.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/cta-check.)

brandId.description: A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands. Required for an account-wide key; a brand-bound key may omit it.

caption.description: The caption, when it differs from the draft.

linkUrl.description: The link the ad or post would use.

objective.description: The ad objective, e.g. traffic, link_clicks, engagement. Click objectives can block; others warn.

name: cta_check
title: Check a CTA before an ad
